goals.title: no module-level mutable state
goals.why: The counters, the settings and the clock are module singletons. Two limiters cannot coexist, a test cannot isolate itself, and every caller shares one hidden object.

goals.title: no import cycle under src/
goals.why: The limiter records denials through the audit log, and the audit log reads the limiter's configuration back. Neither module can be loaded or understood alone.

goals.title: no function is longer than 15 meaningful lines
goals.why: `allow` validates, rolls the window, decides, records and reports in one body.

goals.title: no function has more than 4 branch points
goals.why: The window roll and the limit decision are interleaved, so neither can be changed without re-reading the other.
